# set up
```{r}
# LIBRARIES
library(tidyverse)
library(mgcv)
library(gratia)
library(patchwork)

# DATA
data <- read.csv(
  "../scratch/spatial_predictors/spatial_predictor_data_xy_from_AU_K3_threshold55.csv"
) %>%
  rename(AU = ESU)

clean.data <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(AU))

clean.data$AU <- factor(clean.data$AU)

table(clean.data$AU)

# AU NAMES
AU_names <- c(
  "AU1" = "Western",
  "AU2" = "Eastern",
  "AU3" = "Northern"
)

# COLORS
cols <- readRDS("../../06.final_figures/colors/AU_grouping_colors_K3_colorblind.rds")

# Check that names line up
levels(clean.data$AU)
cols

names(cols) <- AU_names[names(cols)]
cols
```

# Prediction helper functions
```{r}
make_predictions <- function(
    model,
    data,
    focal_var,
    covariate_var,
    restrict_to_AU_range = TRUE,
    n = 200
) {

  # Make sure AU has the same factor levels as model data
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(AU = factor(AU))

  au_levels <- levels(data$AU)

  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # Prediction range
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  if (restrict_to_AU_range) {

  pred_grid <- data %>%
    group_by(AU) %>%
    summarise(
      focal_min = min(.data[[focal_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      focal_max = max(.data[[focal_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      focal_value = list(
        seq(
          from = focal_min,
          to = focal_max,
          length.out = n
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(AU, focal_value) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(focal_value)

} else {

  pred_grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    AU = levels(data$AU),
    focal_value = seq(
      min(data[[focal_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      max(data[[focal_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = n
    )
  )
}

  # Put focal variable into correctly named column
  pred_grid[[focal_var]] <- pred_grid$focal_value
  pred_grid$focal_value <- NULL

  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # Hold non-focal environmental variable at its median
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  pred_grid[[covariate_var]] <- median(
    data[[covariate_var]],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # x and y are required by predict(), even though
  # spatial smooth will be excluded
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  pred_grid$x <- median(data$x, na.rm = TRUE)
  pred_grid$y <- median(data$y, na.rm = TRUE)

  pred_grid$AU <- factor(
    pred_grid$AU,
    levels = levels(data$AU)
  )

  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # Prediction excluding broad spatial adjustment
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  p <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = pred_grid,
    type = "link",
    se.fit = TRUE,
    exclude = "s(x,y)"
  )

  pred_grid <- pred_grid %>%
    mutate(
      fit = as.numeric(p$fit),
      se = as.numeric(p$se.fit),
      lower = fit - 1.96 * se,
      upper = fit + 1.96 * se
    )

  pred_grid
}
```

```{r}
plot_predictions <- function(
    predictions,
    data,
    focal_var,
    x_label,
    title = NULL,
    facet = FALSE,
    show_rug = TRUE
) {

  # Add readable AU labels
  predictions <- predictions %>%
    mutate(
      AU_name = recode(
        as.character(AU),
        !!!AU_names
      )
    )

  plot_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      AU_name = recode(
        as.character(AU),
        !!!AU_names
      )
    )

  p <- ggplot(
    predictions,
    aes(
      x = .data[[focal_var]],
      y = fit,
      color = AU_name,
      fill = AU_name
    )
  ) +

    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper
      ),
      alpha = 0.15,
      colour = NA
    ) +

    geom_line(
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = cols,
      name = "Adaptive Unit"
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = cols,
      name = "Adaptive Unit"
    ) +

    theme_classic() +

    labs(
      x = x_label,
      y = "Predicted abundance trend",
      title = title
    ) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )

  # Observed values along x axis
  if (show_rug) {

    p <- p +
      geom_rug(
        data = plot_data,
        aes(
          x = .data[[focal_var]],
          color = AU_name
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        sides = "b",
        alpha = 0.50,
        linewidth = 0.25
      )
  }

  # Optional facets
  if (facet) {

    p <- p +
      facet_wrap(
        ~ AU_name,
        nrow = 1
      ) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none"
      )
  }

  p
}
```

# Threshold Analysis
## Tmax
```{r}
tmax_grid <- clean.data %>%
  group_by(AU) %>%
  summarise(
    tmin = min(tmax_june_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    tmax = max(tmax_june_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    tmax_june_delta = list(
      seq(tmin, tmax, length.out = 300)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(AU, tmax_june_delta) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(tmax_june_delta)

# Hold precipitation constant at its median
tmax_grid$ppt_june_delta <- median(
  clean.data$ppt_june_delta,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# x/y are needed by predict()
# Holding them constant means their derivative wrt Tmax is zero
tmax_grid$x <- median(clean.data$x, na.rm = TRUE)
tmax_grid$y <- median(clean.data$y, na.rm = TRUE)

tmax_grid$AU <- factor(
  tmax_grid$AU,
  levels = levels(clean.data$AU)
)

# Small finite-difference step
eps_tmax <- diff(
  range(clean.data$tmax_june_delta, na.rm = TRUE)
) / 10000

# Create grids just below and above each Tmax value
tmax_lo <- tmax_grid
tmax_hi <- tmax_grid

tmax_lo$tmax_june_delta <-
  tmax_lo$tmax_june_delta - eps_tmax / 2

tmax_hi$tmax_june_delta <-
  tmax_hi$tmax_june_delta + eps_tmax / 2

# Linear predictor matrices
Xp_lo_tmax <- predict(
  modGS.tmax,
  newdata = tmax_lo,
  type = "lpmatrix"
)

Xp_hi_tmax <- predict(
  modGS.tmax,
  newdata = tmax_hi,
  type = "lpmatrix"
)

# Approximate derivative of the design matrix
Xd_tmax <- (
  Xp_hi_tmax - Xp_lo_tmax
) / eps_tmax
```

```{r}
# Model coefficients
beta_tmax <- coef(modGS.tmax)

# Coefficient covariance matrix
# unconditional = TRUE also incorporates smoothing parameter uncertainty
Vb_tmax <- vcov(
  modGS.tmax,
  unconditional = TRUE
)

# Derivative of the fitted GS curve
tmax_derivative <- as.vector(
  Xd_tmax %*% beta_tmax
)

# SE of derivative, retaining covariance among smooth components
tmax_derivative_se <- sqrt(
  rowSums(
    (Xd_tmax %*% Vb_tmax) * Xd_tmax
  )
)

# Add results to prediction grid
deriv_GS_tmax <- tmax_grid %>%
  mutate(
    derivative = tmax_derivative,
    se = tmax_derivative_se,
    lower = derivative - 1.96 * se,
    upper = derivative + 1.96 * se,

    change = case_when(
      lower > 0 ~ "Increasing",
      upper < 0 ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE ~ "No detectable change"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
head(deriv_GS_tmax)

table(
  deriv_GS_tmax$AU,
  deriv_GS_tmax$change
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  deriv_GS_tmax,
  aes(
```

```{r}
tmax_intervals <- deriv_GS_tmax %>%
  arrange(AU, tmax_june_delta) %>%
  group_by(AU) %>%
  mutate(
    sig_direction = case_when(
      lower > 0 ~ "Increasing",
      upper < 0 ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Start a new interval whenever the significance state changes
    interval_start =
      sig_direction != lag(sig_direction) |
      is.na(sig_direction) != is.na(lag(sig_direction))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    interval_start = replace_na(interval_start, TRUE),
    interval_id = cumsum(interval_start)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sig_direction)) %>%
  group_by(AU, interval_id, sig_direction) %>%
  summarise(
    start_tmax = min(tmax_june_delta),
    end_tmax = max(tmax_june_delta),
    min_derivative = min(derivative),
    max_derivative = max(derivative),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tmax_intervals
```

## Tmin
```{r}
tmin_grid <- clean.data %>%
  group_by(AU) %>%
  summarise(
    tmin = min(tmin_june_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    tmax = max(tmin_june_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    tmin_june_delta = list(
      seq(tmin, tmax, length.out = 300)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(AU, tmin_june_delta) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(tmin_june_delta)

# Hold precipitation constant at its median
tmin_grid$ppt_june_delta <- median(
  clean.data$ppt_june_delta,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Hold spatial coordinates constant
tmin_grid$x <- median(clean.data$x, na.rm = TRUE)
tmin_grid$y <- median(clean.data$y, na.rm = TRUE)

tmin_grid$AU <- factor(
  tmin_grid$AU,
  levels = levels(clean.data$AU)
)

# Small finite-difference step
eps_tmin <- diff(
  range(clean.data$tmin_june_delta, na.rm = TRUE)
) / 10000

# Create grids just below and above each Tmin value
tmin_lo <- tmin_grid
tmin_hi <- tmin_grid

tmin_lo$tmin_june_delta <-
  tmin_lo$tmin_june_delta - eps_tmin / 2

tmin_hi$tmin_june_delta <-
  tmin_hi$tmin_june_delta + eps_tmin / 2

# Linear predictor matrices
Xp_lo_tmin <- predict(
  modGS.tmin,
  newdata = tmin_lo,
  type = "lpmatrix"
)

Xp_hi_tmin <- predict(
  modGS.tmin,
  newdata = tmin_hi,
  type = "lpmatrix"
)

# Approximate derivative of the design matrix
Xd_tmin <- (
  Xp_hi_tmin - Xp_lo_tmin
) / eps_tmin
```

```{r}
# Model coefficients
beta_tmin <- coef(modGS.tmin)

# Coefficient covariance matrix
Vb_tmin <- vcov(
  modGS.tmin,
  unconditional = TRUE
)

# Derivative of fitted GS curve
tmin_derivative <- as.vector(
  Xd_tmin %*% beta_tmin
)

# SE of derivative
tmin_derivative_se <- sqrt(
  rowSums(
    (Xd_tmin %*% Vb_tmin) * Xd_tmin
  )
)

# Add results to prediction grid
deriv_GS_tmin <- tmin_grid %>%
  mutate(
    derivative = tmin_derivative,
    se = tmin_derivative_se,
    lower = derivative - 1.96 * se,
    upper = derivative + 1.96 * se,

    change = case_when(
      lower > 0 ~ "Increasing",
      upper < 0 ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE ~ "No detectable change"
    )
  )
```

# AU level correlation
I noticed that the northern Tmin and Tmax are very similar visually in their prediction curves...
```{r}
clean.data %>%
  group_by(AU) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_tmax_tmin = cor(
      tmax_june_delta,
      tmin_june_delta,
      use = "complete.obs"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
So that makes sense, they're basically 1-1 correlated for the Northern AU (AU3).

```{r}
clean.data %>%
  group_by(AU) %>%
  summarise(
    tmax_min = min(tmax_june_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    tmax_max = max(tmax_june_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    tmin_min = min(tmin_june_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    tmin_max = max(tmin_june_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

So, ranges are nearly identical and they're supper correlated. This means that the Tmin (nighttime temp probably) and Tmax (daytime temp) are changing the same amount 2012-2022.

"In the Northern AU, changes in June maximum and minimum temperature were strongly correlated (r = 0.90) and spanned similar ranges, resulting in highly concordant abundance-response curves for the two temperature metrics."

# Null Model Curves
## Tmax
```{r}
null_tmax_grid <- data.frame(
  tmax_june_delta = seq(
    min(clean.data$tmax_june_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(clean.data$tmax_june_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 300
  )
)

# Hold precipitation constant
null_tmax_grid$ppt_june_delta <- median(
  clean.data$ppt_june_delta,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Needed for prediction, though spatial smooth will be excluded
null_tmax_grid$x <- median(clean.data$x, na.rm = TRUE)
null_tmax_grid$y <- median(clean.data$y, na.rm = TRUE)

# Predictions excluding spatial smooth
pred_null_tmax <- predict(
  null_tmax,
  newdata = null_tmax_grid,
  type = "link",
  se.fit = TRUE,
  exclude = "s(x,y)"
)

null_tmax_grid <- null_tmax_grid %>%
  mutate(
    fit = as.numeric(pred_null_tmax$fit),
    se = as.numeric(pred_null_tmax$se.fit),
    lower = fit - 1.96 * se,
    upper = fit + 1.96 * se
  )

p_null_tmax <- ggplot(
  null_tmax_grid,
  aes(
    x = tmax_june_delta,
    y = fit
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper
    ),
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_rug(
    data = clean.data,
    aes(x = tmax_june_delta),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = expression("Change in June " ~ T[max]),
    y = "Predicted abundance trend",
    title = "Null model: maximum temperature"
  )

p_null_tmax
```
